name: Ecotoxicology ML Benchmark
description: A dataset benchmark for training and evaluating machine learning models on ecotoxicology tasks such as toxicity prediction across assays/species.
reputation: Moderately used in environmental and toxicology ML research but not a widely standardized benchmark across the broader ML community.
notes: Heterogeneous assays and species introduce domain shift; some subsets are small or imbalanced. Primarily a non-LLM benchmark; careful splitting (e.g., by scaffold/species) is required to avoid information leakage.
